description.text: Course Arrangement The courses are given from Monday to Friday. Language Practice BUAA holds activities such as visiting Beijing's scenic spots and places of historical interest, participating in a symposium with Chinese students, watching performances. Certificate Certificates from CLTC will be awarded after the training. Duration 3weeks Application Deadline 2011-10-20 Enrollment and Visas Chinese Language Training Center of BUAA will accept application from both individuals and groups. The applicants must submit the "Application Form" to BUAA before the deadline. After receiving the Admission Notice and JW202 form, the applicants can apply for an "X" or "F" visa from the embassy and consulate of the PRC in the their own countries (Applicants who have an "X" visa need to bring the "Health Examination Result", for the convenience of the residence procedure in China).

duration.text: The Winter Short-Term Chinese Language Class at Beihang University is a 3 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 402 USD/In total ￥ 2900 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: Applicants who are between 18-60 years old and are interested in learning Chinese will be eligible, if they are in good health and are willing to observe the laws and decrees of the People's Republic of China as well as the regulations of BUAA.
